From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Gray <sophie.gray@apertureconsulting.com>, Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@apertureconsulting.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SI Enablement: Rapid Ramp & Toolkit Handoff — Aperture Consulting

Hi Sophie / Ethan,

Congrats again on getting the integration partnership live — excited to have Aperture join the SI network. Per our SOW, we'd like to run a compact enablement sequence to get your delivery teams certified and ready to include Redwood Inference in customer proposals. Proposed goals for the first 10 business days: 

- Deliver partner ramp playbook (process + artefacts)
- Walk technical leads through the integration checklist and reference deployment patterns
- Certify 2-3 consultants with the quick lab + evaluation set
- Handoff sales-ready collateral to your GTM team

I’ve attached a draft Ramp Playbook and the SI Technical Checklist — these are intentionally light so we can customize to Aperture's delivery model. Suggestion for next steps:

1) Kickoff call (60 min): Thurs Dec 3, 10:00-11:00 PT — agenda below
2) Send over the names of the 2 engineers + 1 engagement lead who will take the labs
3) We'll schedule a short follow-up lab session and a recording for asynchronous teams

Proposed kickoff agenda (60 min):
- Introductions & partnership scope (10 min)
- Playback of the Ramp Playbook: roles, timeline, deliverables (10 min)
- Technical checklist walkthrough: reference infra & common pitfalls (20 min)
- Certification steps & timelines (10 min)
- Q&A and immediate actions (10 min)

Attachments: Aperture_Ramp_Playbook_v1.pdf; SI_Technical-Checklist.xlsx; RDW-Aperture-Intro-Deck.pptx

If those times don't work, propose alternatives and I’ll update the invite. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0168
--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime and partner enablement

Tessa, thank you — this looks great. We’re ready to move forward and the team is excited. Confirming the kickoff for Thu Dec 3 at 10:00 PT works for our US delivery leads.

Attendees I’ll bring:
- Ethan Miller (Principal Engineer)
- Priya Natarajan (Engagement Lead)
- Rachel Kim (Solution Architect) — will dial in for the checklist segment

Two quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you add a short pre-kickoff worksheet so we can gather our environment details (cloud regions, VPC constraints, key management)?
- Will the certification lab require dedicated GPUs or can engineers run the labs on individual workstations with small test models?

We’ll review the attachments and post any clarifying questions ahead of the call.

Cheers,

Team — forwarding Aperture's RSVP and a couple of pre-kickoff asks. Quick coordination notes: 

- Sophie asked for a pre-kickoff worksheet capturing environment details. Can someone trim the long onboarding form into a 1-pager? Goal: one A4 that the engagement lead can complete in under 15 minutes.
- Certification lab hardware: default plan is to run on laptop + tiny test models (CPU/cheap GPU). If we need dedicated GPUs, we should offer our sandbox reservation window (2x T4s for a 2-hour lab).
- Laura: can you own the kickoff agenda and slide deck update? I attached the RDW-Aperture-Intro-Deck.pptx as a starting point.
- Karthik: please confirm whether the lab can be done entirely with developer workstations or if we should reserve the sandbox. If we need to reserve, can you propose two slots next week?

I’ve copied Dylan for engineering availability and to ask that we record the walkthrough.

Thanks — this is a fast-turn engagement and great visibility for the partner program.

-Tessa

Tessa — quick update after checking infra and sandbox availability.

- Lab hardware: the hands-on lab can run on developer workstations for the basic exercises (CPU or single-GPU laptop). For the inference latency and batching module we recommend a short dedicated instance with a small GPU. I can provision a sandbox with 1x T4 for a 2-hour window.
- Proposed slots for the sandbox next week: Mon Dec 7 14:00-16:00 PT or Tue Dec 8 09:00-11:00 PT. Please confirm which works for Aperture and I’ll reserve.
- I created a 1-page pre-kickoff worksheet and uploaded it to the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ApertureRamp (file: Aperture_PreKick_Worksheet.docx). It’s intentionally brief: cloud provider, primary region, VPC peering required (y/n), KMS/HSM required (y/n), sample throughput target.

Laura — I pulled the RDW-Aperture-Intro-Deck.pptx and trimmed two slides to add the sandbox lab logistics and certification checklist.

I’ll be on the kickoff and can run the technical checklist segment.

— Karthik
